source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks WHERE { { SELECT DISTINCT ?item WHERE { ?item wdt:P105 wd:Q7432 ; wdt:P171+ wd:Q25308 . } } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks .
